 Gold rate today: Gold rates have shown a marginal decrease today across major jewellery brands in India, reflecting updated pricing. Meanwhile, cities like Chennai, Hyderabad, and Bengaluru also report 22k gold priced similarly at Rs 12,590 per gram. The prices are likely to vary based on the city and jeweller, warranting prior checking before purchases. Listen to this article in summarized format
 Listen ET Online 24k 22k 18k Gold Price today city wise Gold rates decreased marginally today (Monday, November 16, 2026) at key jewellery brands like Malabar Gold & Diamonds, Joyalukkas, Kalyan Jewellers and Tanishq. The India Bullion and Jewellers Association Ltd.’s (IBJA) latest available gold and silver jewellery indicative rates are for November 13, as its November 16 prices are yet to be updated. Gold and silver prices are worth checking before making a jewellery purchase, as rates can vary across cities and jewellers.
 Gold and silver rates today (Monday, November 16, 2026)
Here is a look at 22k gold jewellery rates from Tanishq, Malabar Gold & Diamonds, Kalyan Jewellers and Joyalukkas across New Delhi, Mumbai, Chennai and Kolkata. Also have a look at the IBJA’s 24k, 22k, 20k, 18k and 14k indicative gold jewellery rates and the 999-purity silver jewellery indicative price.
